Title: Equivalence of Definitions of Adjunction

Let $\mathbf {Set}$ be the [[Definition:Category of Sets|category of sets]].

Let $\mathbf C$, $\mathbf D$ be [[Definition:Locally Small Category|locally small categories]].

{{TFAE|def = Adjunction}}

=== [[Definition:Adjunction/Definition 1|Definition 1]] ===
An '''[[Definition:Adjunction|adjunction]]''' between $\mathbf C$ and $\mathbf D$ is a triple $\tuple {F, G, \alpha}$, where

:$F : \mathbf D \to \mathbf C$ is a [[Definition:Covariant Functor|covariant functor]].

:$G : \mathbf C \to \mathbf D$ is a [[Definition:Covariant Functor|covariant functor]].

:$\alpha: \map {\mathrm {Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {F-, -} \to \map {\mathrm {Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {-, G-}$ is a [[Definition:Natural Isomorphism|natural isomorphism]] between:

::the [[Definition:Hom Bifunctor With Left Functor|hom bifunctor with left functor]] $\map {\mathrm {Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {F-, -} : \mathbf D^{\mathrm {op}} \times \mathbf C \to \mathbf{Set}$

:and:

::the [[Definition:Hom Bifunctor With Right Functor|hom bifunctor with right functor]] $\map {\mathrm {Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {-, G-} : \mathbf D^{\mathrm {op} } \times \mathbf C \to \mathbf{Set}$

=== [[Definition:Adjunction/Definition 2|Definition 2]] ===
An '''[[Definition:Adjunction|adjunction]]''' between $\mathbf C$ and $\mathbf D$ is a triple $\tuple {F, G, \alpha}$, where

:$F : \mathbf D \to \mathbf C$ is a [[Definition:Covariant Functor|covariant functor]].

:$G : \mathbf C \to \mathbf D$ is a [[Definition:Covariant Functor|covariant functor]].

and:

:$\alpha$ associates with:
::$D^\text{op}$ in $\mathbf D^\text{op}$ and $C$ in $\mathbf C$
:a [[Definition:Bijection|bijection]]:
::$\alpha_{\tuple{D^\text{op}, C} } : \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {FD, C} \to \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {D, GC}$
:such that:
::for all $f^\text{op}: D_1^\text{op} \to D_2^\text{op}$ in $\mathbf D^\text{op}$ and $g: C_1 \to C_2$ in $\mathbf C$:
:::$\alpha_{\tuple{D_2^\text{op},C_2}} \circ \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C}} {Ff^\text{op}, g} = \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D}} {f^\text{op}, Gg} \circ \alpha_{\tuple{D_1^\text{op},C_1}}$
::where:
:::$\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C}} {Ff^\text{op}, g} : \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {FD_1, C_1} \to \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {FD_2, C_2}$ is the [[Definition:Mapping|mapping]] defined by : $h \mapsto g \circ h \circ Ff$
:::$\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D}} {f^\text{op}, Gg} : \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {D_1, GC_1} \to \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {D_2, GC_2}$ is the [[Definition:Mapping|mapping]] defined by : $h \mapsto Gg \circ h \circ f$

::that is, the following [[Definition:Commutative Diagram|diagram commutes]]:

::<nowiki>$\begin{xy}
<0em,6em>*+{\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {FD_1, C_1} } = "C",
<15em,6em>*+{\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {FD_2, C_2} } = "C2",
<0em,0em>*+{\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {D_1, GC_1} } = "D",
<15em,0em>*+{\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {D_2, GC_2} } = "D2",

"C";"C2" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1em/{\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {Ff^\text{op}, g} },
"D";"D2" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/^1em/{\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf D} } {f^\text{op}, Gg} },
"C";"D" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/^1.8em/{\alpha_{\tuple{D_1^\text{op}, C_1} } },
"C2";"D2" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1.8em/{\alpha_{\tuple{D_2^\text{op}, C_2} } },
\end{xy}$</nowiki>
